user.title: Connect Sophos XGS
user.description: Credentials of a firewall administrator for the XML API. Enable the API under Backup & firmware → API and allow the Home Assistant IP.

entities.title: Select entities
entities.description: Choose interfaces for traffic/link sensors and firewall rules to expose as switches. You can change this later in the options.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Login to the XML API failed. Please enter the credentials again.

error.cannot_connect_snmp: No SNMP response. Check SNMP agent, community/user, manager IP and device access (SNMP on the zone).
error.cannot_connect_api: XML API unreachable. Check host, port and device access (HTTPS admin).
error.api_access_denied: API access denied: enable the API and add the Home Assistant IP to the allowed IP addresses.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Connect to the firewall first.

license_expiring.title: Sophos license expiring soon: {license}
license_expiring.description:
The **{license}** license of firewall **{firewall}** expires in **{days} days** (on {date}).

Please renew it in time. The warning lead time can be changed in the integration options (0 = off).

license_expired.title: Sophos license expired: {license}
license_expired.description:
The **{license}** license of firewall **{firewall}** has expired. The related protection features are limited or disabled.

If you intentionally do not renew this license, you can ignore this issue.
